history.p: Gade got the idea for his third symphony in the summer of 1846, but ran apparently into certain difficulties, for he wrote the first version of the first movement in September 1846, another one in June 1847 and the final one in November that year. When it had its first performance in the Gewandhaus on 9 December it was received with rapturous acclamation and became one of the most frequently performed of all Gade's symphonies in Leipzig.

With many corrections in red ink and a single in pencil.
